arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: short production animation strip for HARVEST THE NIGHT, a cozy pixel-art farm defended against zombies.
Input images: Image 1 is the standing dog identity master: exact breed, face, fur markings, body proportions and camera reference. Image 2 is the owner-approved sitting dog, identity and caramel/cream color reference only; do not copy its sitting pose into this action. Image 3 is the approved game style reference, not a request to draw its scene.
Use exactly the same friendly medium farm dog in every frame: collie/shepherd type, caramel back, ears and bushy tail, cream forehead stripe, muzzle, chest, paws and tail tip; dark nose/eye, upright ears with folded tips, no collar or accessories. It is not a wolf, a plush mascot or a new breed.
All poses face LEFT/WEST with the same three-quarter top-down farm camera. Upper-left daytime highlights; deliberate square pixel-art clusters, colored outlines and a limited warm wood/bone ramp. No 3D, painting, smooth gradients, blur, antialiasing or dithering.
Final native frame canvas is 40x32, contact pivot (20,30), draw scale 1.0. Normal standing body is 22 pixels wide and 16 pixels tall, half the farmer height. Keep the same torso mass, head/ear size and fur markings across the strip. Do not individually enlarge poses or center each pose by its changing silhouette.
Layout: one clean horizontal row of equal-size source cells, with generous fully transparent gutters between poses. Keep the dog's torso at the same cell-center x and every grounded paw on the same source baseline; preserve complete unclipped tails and ears. The exporter will use ONE uniform content_scale for the whole strip. No labels, borders or separators, no extra still pose.
True transparent background outside the dog. No ground, shadow, grass, kennel, person, enemy, impact, motion streaks, sound glyphs, text, UI, glow, halo, extra objects or night lighting.
Generate exactly THREE frames of dog_bite in order, 0.1 seconds each, one-shot: 1) crouch with weight back, head facing LEFT, jaws closed; 2) eager working-dog lunge toward the LEFT, jaws OPEN aimed at a zombie's shin height; the front paws may lift but hind paws support the dog, torso stays inside the cell; 3) recover with mouth closed and all paws down, ending in the standing master stance. Preserve head/torso proportions and dog identity. Native open-jaw tip should land near x=4..9, y=17..22 on the 40x32 canvas; create readable open jaws without a huge monstrous mouth. Do not include a zombie, blood, impact, contact particles or target. A bite metadata point will be measured from the opaque jaw tip later.
Image 4 is the existing walker sprite, a bite-height reference only; never draw it or any target into the dog strip.

roles: walker bite-height reference only, never drawn
